title: Grayton Gold | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the open-concept living area welcomes with vaulted ceilings, designer furnishings, and seamless flow to a breezy balcony perfect for sunset cocktails. The chef’s kitchen impresses with premium appliances like a Wolf range and Sub-Zero fridge, while bunk spaces and luxe king suites provide flexibility for larger groups. From rooftop sunrises to movie nights in the plush great room, every detail invites relaxation and connection in a setting that’s equal parts stylish and serene. A modern beach retreat designed for memory-making, this five-bedroom home offers an elevated 30A experience just steps from the shoreline. Centered around a private heated pool and outdoor kitchen, the home blends relaxed coastal living with upscale amenities, including a rooftop lookout with sweeping Gulf views. A six-seater golf cart and six beach cruisers make exploring the neighborhood effortless, while an elevator adds convenience across all levels.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
